summary: RevenueCat subscription integration reviewed. BACKEND REGRESSION: 84/84 pytest passed in 9.71s (test_tracepro_api.py + test_iteration3_features.py + test_iteration4_features.py + test_export_query_token.py) — no regressions. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, web Test Store): after login as test@tracepro.fr, unsubscribed user IS correctly redirected to /paywall (testID paywall-screen). Paywall renders all required elements: 'TRACEPRO / Abonnement PRO' header, orange trial banner '15 JOURS GRATUITS' with 'puis €12.99 / mois' (real RevenueCat priceString) + full auto-renewal disclosure, 6 benefits, buttons paywall-subscribe / paywall-restore / paywall-manage, disclosures footer with once-per-account trial notice, and legal links paywall-terms + paywall-privacy (both navigate to legal-screen — verified for terms). No paywall-identity-error, no paywall-unavailable. NO FAKE ACTIVATION confirmed: grep across app/ + src/ shows Pro access is driven ONLY by useSubscription().isSubscribed (RevenueCat entitlement 'pro') — the AuthGate in _layout.tsx, index.tsx tab, and settings.tsx all consume useSubscription; no stripe_status/isPro/local boolean is read anywhere in the app for gating. CRITICAL FINDING: paywall-subscribe button stays DISABLED (aria-disabled=true) for 30+ seconds after landing on the paywall — identityReady never flips to true in RevenueCat Web Browser Mode, and no identity-error is surfaced either (silent). This blocks the entire purchase flow on web (confirm modal never opens). Details in rca_of_issue. Also observed a cosmetic RC warning: 'Could not find product data for product ids: pro.annual' — a stray package in the 'default' offering that has no matching Test Store product; monthly $rc_monthly is fine. Purchase completion via web Test Store popup was NOT attempted (per instructions, that is expected). Settings screen verified via code review only (gate prevents reaching it without entitlement) — uses useSubscription (real RC status), testIDs subscribe-now / manage-sub / restore-purchases / settings-terms / settings-privacy present and correctly wired.

ui_bugs.issue: paywall-subscribe button remains DISABLED (aria-disabled=true) indefinitely on web preview because identityReady never becomes true — Purchases.logIn(user.id) does not (visibly) transition originalAppUserId away from '$RCAnonymousID:*' in RevenueCat Web Browser Mode, and the catch block does not surface an identityError either. Consequence: end-to-end test-store purchase flow cannot be initiated on web (confirm modal never opens).

integration_issues.issue: src/revenuecat.tsx L63-81 awaits Purchases.logIn(user.id) but on web Browser Mode the customerInfo query still resolves with $RCAnonymousID:* even after logIn, and the identityError state stays null. Either (a) log the logIn result and force-set the customer-info cache from its return value, (b) fall back to identityReady=true when user is authenticated on web (test-store only), or (c) show paywall-identity-error when identityReady stays false for >5s post-login so it is at least user-visible.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking, not in app code.
'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — already gated by Platform.OS==='web' in reminders.

action_items: FIX identity binding on web: in src/revenuecat.tsx, after `await Purchases.logIn(user.id)`, use the returned `{ customerInfo }` to seed the query cache directly (queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo)) instead of only invalidating; also consider setting a timeout that flips identityError='identity_not_ready_web' when originalAppUserId stays anonymous >5s so paywall-identity-error becomes visible.

OPTIONAL: On web (Platform.OS==='web' && __DEV__), relax the paywall-subscribe disabled condition to allow tapping when the user is authenticated (the purchase mutation itself already re-checks identity via `Purchases.getCustomerInfo().originalAppUserId` and throws 'identity_not_ready'). This lets QA exercise the confirm modal and the RC Test Store popup on web.

CLEAN-UP: Remove or reconfigure the stray 'pro.annual' package in the 'default' RevenueCat offering — RC logs 'Could not find product data for product ids: pro.annual' on every page load. Only $rc_monthly is used by the app.
Backend has no action items — 84/84 tests still green.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx AuthGate: gate is driven solely by useSubscription().isSubscribed. Correct — no fake activation possible from the client.

settings.tsx: subscription card reads isSubscribed / inTrial / expirationDate from useSubscription (RevenueCat). Buttons switch between subscribe-now and manage-sub based on isSubscribed. Correct wiring.

revenuecat.tsx: purchase mutation guards with `if (id.startsWith('$RCAnonymousID:')) throw 'identity_not_ready'` — good defense-in-depth. However identityReady in the paywall gates the button BEFORE this ever runs, so on web the flow is fully blocked (see UI bug above).

server.py: legacy /subscription/subscribe|cancel|status endpoints still exist and are not consumed by the app anymore (verified by grep in frontend). Tests still pass — safe to keep for now, but consider a deprecation note.

Legal screen: terms + privacy content includes all Apple-required disclosures (price 12,99€, 15-day trial, once-per-Apple-ID, auto-renew, cancel-24h-before, no prorated refund, data-retention on expiry). Compliant.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Use testIDs login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button (NOT login-email/login-password). 2) After login, user MUST land at /paywall — verify testID paywall-screen. 3) On web the RevenueCat priceString is formatted as '€12.99' (en-US style) even for FR locale — do NOT assert exact '12,99 €' string; assert presence of '€' and '12' & '99' digits, and the '15 JOURS GRATUITS' banner. 4) On web preview, paywall-subscribe is currently DISABLED because identityReady never turns true — after fix, poll aria-disabled=false for up to 10s before clicking. 5) Settings screen is UNREACHABLE on web while paywall gate is active — verify it via code review or by (temporarily) forcing an entitlement.
rca_of_issue: REPRO: 1) open https://food-traceability-1.preview.emergentagent.com in a 390x844 viewport; 2) login as test@tracepro.fr/password123; 3) app redirects to /paywall; 4) inspect [data-testid=paywall-subscribe]. OBSERVED: aria-disabled stays 'true' for at least 30s; console repeatedly shows originalAppUserId='$RCAnonymousID:*' and never logs a successful Purchases.logIn. No [data-testid=paywall-identity-error] is rendered. ROOT CAUSE: In src/revenuecat.tsx the identity useEffect calls `await Purchases.logIn(user.id)` then `queryClient.invalidateQueries` — but on RevenueCat Web Browser Mode the SDK's getCustomerInfo() continues to return the anonymous customer info (the SDK's internal storage in browser mode does not migrate identity synchronously to a refetch). Because identityReady is computed from that customerInfo it stays false; the paywall button is `disabled={isPurchasing || !identityReady}` and never enables. No error is thrown either, so the identity-error branch never renders. MITIGATION: after logIn, seed the query cache with the returned customerInfo via `queryClient.setQueryData(['revenuecat','customer-info'], customerInfo)` and additionally start a 5s timer that flips identityError to a visible string if originalAppUserId is still anonymous — that way either the button becomes tappable or the user sees paywall-identity-error and knows to reconnect.
